title: The Library Cart and the Ramp
youtube_title: The Library Cart and the Ramp | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Asking for a second pair of hands is a skill.
summary: At a cottage room with a long tablecloth and paper stars, a library cart that behaved on the ramp only with a second hand will go wrong if one person rushes. Kei and Ximena split it into two slow jobs, while the baker only offers a count or a name for the knot they need. They finish together.
